player_prompt.intro:
You are Player {player_id} playing a game of Checkers as {color}.
Make your move in chess-style notation [fileRank fileRank], e.g. '[b2c3]' (column letter a–h, row digit 0–7).
Basic rules:
  • Move diagonally forward by 1 if empty.
  • Capture by jumping over an opponent piece.
  • A piece is Kinged if it reaches the opposite end.

invalid_move.wrong_format: Nen formato de movimento valido trovòu. Üze [a1b2], pe esempio [b2c3].

game_action.moved: O zugatô {player_id} o l'à fæto un movimento {move}.

outcome.red_no_pieces: Red has no pieces left. Black wins!
outcome.black_no_pieces: O nero o no gh'à ciù de peççe, e o roso o vinse!
outcome.no_moves: O zugatô {player_id} o no gh'à ciù de mosse.
outcome.draw: O limite de rotaçion o l'é stæto raggiunto.
